guard: Run callers and trusted mediator grants preserve the authenticated owner without widening driver grants
why: User-auth workflow effects cannot run as the static local owner.
These cells call the shipped caller and grant builders. They do not prove admission or hosted execution.

mutations.name: C1 discard the admitted caller owner
mutations.replace: return { owner: DEV_OWNER, actor: `wf_${h.slice(0, 12)}`, uid: h.slice(12, 38) };
mutations.expectRed: run caller keeps the admitted owner

mutations.name: C2 discard the mediator owner
mutations.expectRed: run mediator replies to the admitted owner

mutations.name: C3 accept an arbitrary caller owner
mutations.expectRed: run caller refuses arbitrary owner tokens
